fixed.other: Same camera matrix/ortho scale/clips, world/lights, exposure/color transform, current normals/weights/geometry and animation. No auto-refit after hiding coat.
fixed.scene: Hash-bound prior exported-preview source.blend; load with use_scripts=False

modes.purpose: Reproduction control. Compare to saved exported pose0001 and report actual pixel differences; no invented acceptance tolerance.

modes.changes: Only hide exact PortableEdgeFringe object after proving every polygon uses sole material SourceColoredFringe. Do not zero alpha or delete faces.
modes.purpose: Contribution of fringe including occlusion and shadows, not only its texture.

modes.changes: Coat remains hidden. Replace only five body materials with one explicit opaque constant linear-gray diffuse/matte material; remove normal/roughness/metal textures but retain authored custom normals. Dragon materials unchanged.
modes.purpose: Remove body texture/normal-map material signals; not a geometry-only pass.

modes.changes: Coat remains hidden. Connect each original body Principled Base Color graph to emission strength1; preserve original UV0, factor, sampler and sRGB handling. Use original constant color when unlinked. Dragon materials unchanged.
modes.purpose: Find artifacts carried by baked/basecolor appearance without light/normal-map response. Does not prove geometric integrity.

pitfalls: Restore pristine material slots and hide flags before each mode; avoid accumulating mutations across controls.
Do not change AgX/exposure or compare emission pixel RGB directly to source PNG bytes as if color transforms were absent.
Gray residuals can be authored-normal lighting, shadows or overlapping geometry. Unlit disappearance alone cannot prove the mesh is sound.
Optional normal emission must use evaluated geometric face normals, not interpolated/custom shading normals; first use the separately owned CPU contour/contact evidence.
Record exact loaded scene/model hashes, mode material names, rig/bone pose proof and camera/light settings; keep all output in new diagnostic folders.
No second camera is needed unless the fixed view demonstrably hides the cheek/shoulder target; no geometry, skin, UV or source texture changes are authorized by this diagnostic.
recommendation: Four modes in one fixed existing three-quarter camera at dance_flight1.36s are sufficient for the first attribution screen; do not add a full view sweep.

source_contract.body: All five listed body materials are opaque and double-sided; basecolor textures use UV0, tail-base is a constant factor.
source_contract.fringe: Separate PortableEdgeFringe mesh, sole material SourceColoredFringe, single-sided MASK .18.
source_contract.normal_maps: Adaptive body-cap normal texture uses UV1; unlit must use basecolor UV0 instead. Gray removes maps but does not replace custom normals.
